about.hero_desc: Our jewelry is born slowly. Without haste, without plan, allowing the form to become what it wants to be.
about.history_p1:
Payka was born in 2023 in a small home studio. With nothing more than a simple soldering iron, a few tools, and a strong desire to create jewelry meant for everyday wear.

It all began with a search for the perfect ring for myself — simple, comfortable, something that feels like a natural extension of the hand. When it couldn’t be found, we decided to create it ourselves.

Today, Payka is silver jewelry, handcrafted with a love for imperfections, textures, and small details.
about.history_p2:
Behind every Payka piece is Alina — the founder and maker of the brand, who fell in love with working with metal long before the first collection came to life.

Inspired by organic forms and the imperfect beauty of handmade objects, she continues to craft each piece in small batches. This approach allows every item to carry its own character, the warmth of human hands, and a sense of quiet uniqueness.
about.mission_desc: To create jewelry meant to be worn for years — simple, distinctive, and handcrafted in silver. We believe true beauty lives in details that stand the test of time.
about.vision_desc: We create jewelry for those who find beauty in simplicity and thoughtful details. These are pieces that don’t demand attention, but naturally become part of everyday life and the stories we carry with us.
about.alina_desc: Specializes in creating jewelry and exploring experimental metal textures.
about.m2023: Launched the Payka home studio and began collaborating with its first retail partner in Ivano-Frankivsk.
about.m2025: Beginning of another partnership with a retail store in the Vinnytsia region.
about.footer_desc: We invite you to explore our collection and find a piece that speaks to your heart.
about.contact_desc: Have questions about a piece or a custom order? We'd love to hear from you.

shipping.title: Shipping, exchanges & returns
shipping.intro: Everything you need to know before ordering — so shopping feels clear and calm.
shipping.shipping_intro: We ship across Ukraine after your order is confirmed with us.
shipping.shipping_time: Estimated delivery: usually 1–2 business days after the parcel is handed to Nova Poshta (may vary by city).
shipping.shipping_process: Process: place order → we contact you to confirm details → we make / prepare the piece → we send the tracking number.
shipping.exchange_intro: Ordered the wrong ring size? We can usually help with an exchange.
shipping.exchange_eligibility: Eligible if the piece is unused, undamaged, and returned in the original packaging.
shipping.exchange_window: Please contact us within 14 days of receiving your order to arrange a size exchange.
shipping.exchange_process: Process: message us with your order number and the correct size → we agree on the exchange → you send the piece back via Nova Poshta → we remake or resize and ship the replacement.
shipping.returns_intro: Because each piece is handmade, returns are considered case by case.
shipping.returns_eligibility: A return may be possible if the item is unused, in original condition and packaging, and you contact us within 14 days of delivery.
shipping.returns_not_eligible: Custom or made-to-order pieces, and items showing signs of wear, are generally not eligible for return.
shipping.returns_process: Process: message us with your order number and reason → we confirm eligibility → return shipping via Nova Poshta is arranged → refund or store credit is agreed once we receive and check the piece.
shipping.contact_desc: Write to us on Instagram with your order number — we’ll guide you through shipping, an exchange, or a return.
